layout: row-major; row = observer radius; texel = (R, G) interleaved

channel.R: lensRegular = delta + ln tanh((psi - alpha_sh)/alpha_sh), rad

column.max: ln((pi - alpha_sh)/alpha_sh) of the row; the last column is psi = pi exactly

generator.G: central difference of R in x (one-sided at the ends) + d/dx ln-tanh singular part
